items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: No, he was strictly a songwriter.

ctx.x: And you have another one down here that used to write songs. He was a good friend of Pinky's. What the hell was his name?
Al Josen, you mean? The one we used to call Al Josen? Did he play? No, he was strictly a songwriter.
He used to write the politician songs? No, no, no, no. You wrote a lot of things.
